description: Near-term Enyo NNUE experiment: train the existing legacy-layout Enyo net with Bullet directly from a proven Stockfish NNUE binpack instead of generating more Enyo self-play.
hypothesis: A high-quality external Stockfish NNUE binpack plus Bullet training may provide useful broad signal while preserving the current Enyo/Berserk-derived starting weights.
gates: init-export parity must match the current reference before training is trusted
net-diff must show intended exported movement
static validation must not clearly regress sign/MAE
composite search/move gate must improve capped gap or top-move behavior without mate-like regression
failure-suite replay must not introduce an unacceptable tail
SPRT only if cheap gates are clean
